title: Towards Inference-time Scaling for Continuous Space Reasoning
authors_zh: Minghan Wang、Thuy-Trang Vu、Gholamreza Haffari（莫纳什大学）；Ehsan Shareghi（伦敦大学学院）
paper_type_zh: 连续隐空间测试时扩展分析
best_for_zh: 希望把采样与验证器扩展从文本思维链迁移到潜在或连续推理表征的读者。
one_line: This paper shows that latent reasoning has unused Pass@N potential but weak reward-model separability, then tests geometric regularization to improve its test-time scaling.
本文显示隐空间推理虽有尚未利用的通过率上界，却因奖励模型可分性弱而难以扩展，并以几何正则化测试改进测试时扩展的可能。
why: It establishes that standard verifier recipes cannot simply be assumed to transfer from text traces to continuous thoughts, a key boundary for generalizing test-time scaling.
inclusion_reason: It tests whether multiple-sample verification and reranking actually scale latent continuous reasoning, and identifies why conventional PRM/ORM recipes fail to allocate test-time compute effectively in that space.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multiple sampled text chains can be reranked by process or outcome reward models, making test-time scaling effective in ordinary language-space reasoning. Continuous reasoning models instead perform intermediate computation in hidden representations. They can sample diverse latent paths, but it is not established whether the same verification and reranking recipes can recognize good paths well enough to turn that diversity into accuracy.

The paper asks whether latent-space reasoning has a usable inference-time scaling curve and, if not, where the failure arises. A high Pass@N would show that correct solutions occur among samples, while weak reranking would show that the system cannot identify them. The challenge is to separate correct from incorrect continuous thought trajectories without explicit textual reasoning steps, so the search budget can be converted into a better final answer rather than merely more latent samples.

多个采样的文本推理链可以由过程或结果奖励模型重排序，从而让测试时扩展在普通语言空间推理中有效。连续推理模型则在隐藏表征中完成中间计算。它们能够采样多样的潜在路径，但尚不清楚同样的验证和重排序配方能否足够准确地识别好路径，从而把这种多样性转化为准确率。

论文研究潜在空间推理是否拥有可用的测试时扩展曲线；若没有，失败发生在哪里。较高的通过率上界说明正确解会出现在样本之中，而较弱的重排序说明系统无法把它识别出来。难点是没有显式文本推理步骤时，如何区分正确与错误的连续思维轨迹，使搜索预算转化为更好的最终答案，而不只是生成更多潜在样本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The authors first expose a gap between latent-path availability and latent-path selection. Dropout-based sampling gives COCONUT multiple distinct answers and a growing Pass@N curve, so additional test-time samples contain useful potential. Yet confidence, self-consistency, and reward-model reranking recover only a small portion of it because correct and incorrect latent trajectories occupy insufficiently separable representation regions.

Their response is both diagnostic and constructive. They measure reward-model discrimination, geometric distribution, and trajectory dynamics to locate the bottleneck, then add a lightweight post-training objective that gives correct and incorrect answer-verified rollouts more distinguishable geometric behavior. The goal is not to claim that a standard text-space PRM works in latent space, but to show what representation property must improve before verifier-guided scaling can work reliably.

作者首先揭示潜在路径可获得性和潜在路径选择之间的缺口。基于丢弃法的采样让 COCONUT 产生多个不同答案，并带来上升的通过率上界曲线，所以额外测试时样本中确实含有有用潜力。然而，置信度、自一致性和奖励模型重排序只能恢复其中很小一部分，因为正确与错误的潜在轨迹在表征空间中的可分性不足。

他们的回应既是诊断性的，也是建设性的。论文测量奖励模型判别性、几何分布和轨迹动态以定位瓶颈，再加入轻量后训练目标，让经答案验证的正确与错误轨迹具有更可区分的几何行为。目标不是宣称标准文本空间过程奖励模型可直接用于潜在空间，而是说明验证器引导扩展要可靠发挥作用，表征的哪一种性质必须先得到改善。

title: Method
方法
html:
Using COCONUT on GSM8K, the study creates diverse continuous trajectories through dropout sampling and evaluates Best-of-N from one to 32 samples. It adapts Math-Shepherd-style automatic annotation to train a step PRM and outcome reward model: five paths per training prompt, answer-based deduplication, and ten Monte Carlo completions per step yield 238,000 PRM and 324,000 ORM training records. Reranking is compared with model confidence and self-consistency on un-deduplicated test candidates.

To explain limited gains, the authors construct a 3,014-sample analysis set and evaluate reward classification, calibration, isotropy, sparsity, compactness, straightness, curvature, and local smoothness. They then perform dropout rollouts whose final answers are checked against ground truth and introduce a geometric regularization objective inspired by contrastive learning and verifiable-reward training. The intervention is evaluated by both Pass@N and PRM/ORM reranking before and after post-training.

研究在 GSM8K 上使用 COCONUT，通过丢弃法采样生成多样的连续轨迹，并在一到 32 个样本下评估最佳候选采样。它改造 Math-Shepherd 式自动标注来训练步骤过程奖励模型和结果奖励模型：每个训练提示生成五条路径，按最终答案去重，并为每一步生成十个蒙特卡洛完成结果，得到 238,000 条过程奖励模型和 324,000 条结果奖励模型训练记录。重排序在未去重的测试候选上与模型置信度和自一致性比较。

为解释增益有限的原因，作者构建 3,014 条样本的分析集，评估奖励分类、校准、各向同性、稀疏性、紧致度、直线性、曲率和局部平滑度。随后，他们生成最终答案可由真值核验的丢弃法轨迹，并引入受对比学习和可验证奖励训练启发的几何正则化目标。该干预以前后训练的通过率上界以及过程、结果奖励模型重排序共同评估。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The raw sampling result establishes meaningful but unrealized scaling headroom. On GSM8K at 32 samples, COCONUT reaches a 44.96% Pass@N upper bound, yet confidence reranking remains at 31.92%, self-consistency at 34.04%, PRM hard-estimation reranking at 34.04%, and ORM at 32.68%. Thus the best listed reranker improves over one-sample accuracy only modestly and remains more than ten points below the answer-oracle bound.

The diagnostic results support the proposed bottleneck. On the constructed analysis set, PRM and ORM have F1 scores of 54.09% and 51.59%, with low precision and high expected calibration error. Correct and incorrect thoughts have nearly identical isotropy and sparsity statistics, and trajectory effects are generally small. After geometric regularization, Pass@32 rises from 44.96% to 48.22%, while PRM reranking rises from 34.04% to 34.57%; the improvement is real but also shows that better latent separability remains an open problem.

原始采样结果表明存在有意义但尚未实现的扩展空间。在 GSM8K 的 32 个样本下，COCONUT 达到 44.96% 的通过率上界；但置信度重排序仍为 31.92%，自一致性为 34.04%，过程奖励模型硬估计重排序为 34.04%，结果奖励模型为 32.68%。因此，列出的最佳重排序器相对一次采样准确率只带来有限改善，仍比答案预知上界低十多个百分点。

诊断结果支持所提出的瓶颈。在构建的分析集上，过程与结果奖励模型的 F1 分数分别为 54.09% 和 51.59%，精确率较低且期望校准误差较高。正确与错误思维在各向同性和稀疏性统计上几乎相同，轨迹效应整体也很小。几何正则化后，通过率上界在 32 个样本时从 44.96% 提升到 48.22%，过程奖励模型重排序从 34.04% 升到 34.57%；改善真实存在，但也说明更好的潜在可分性仍是开放问题。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper contributes a negative transfer result that is unusually useful for test-time scaling: diverse continuous trajectories can create the same kind of candidate-set opportunity as textual chains, but standard text-derived verifier supervision does not make those trajectories rankable. It separates “can generate a correct candidate” from “can score a correct candidate,” preventing Pass@N alone from being mistaken for an end-to-end scaling result.

It also ties this failure to representation geometry rather than leaving it as a generic reward-model weakness. By analyzing correct and incorrect latent trajectories and then making a small answer-verified geometric intervention, the paper turns a transfer failure into a concrete research target. This reframes test-time compute in continuous reasoning as a joint sampling-and-discrimination problem rather than a direct reuse of textual Best-of-N recipes.

论文给出了对测试时扩展格外有用的负迁移结果：多样的连续轨迹可以像文本推理链一样创造候选集机会，但从文本派生出的标准验证器监督不能让这些轨迹可靠排序。它区分了“能够生成正确候选”和“能够为正确候选打分”，避免人们把通过率上界本身误认为端到端扩展结果。

它还把这种失败联系到表征几何，而不是笼统归因于奖励模型弱。通过分析正确和错误潜在轨迹，再进行小规模、由答案核验的几何干预，论文把迁移失败变成具体研究目标。这使连续推理的测试时计算被重新表述为采样与判别的联合问题，而不是直接复用文本最佳候选采样配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The empirical study is centered on COCONUT and GSM8K, so it cannot establish that all latent-reasoning architectures share the same geometry or scaling limit. Automatic Math-Shepherd-style labels may be noisy when applied to non-textual thought, and the post-training intervention produces only modest reranking gains. Although code is released, reproducing the result requires substantial latent-model and reward-model training; the work diagnoses a limitation more convincingly than it supplies a universal remedy.
实证研究以 COCONUT 和 GSM8K 为中心，因此不能证明所有潜在推理架构都具有相同几何或扩展限制。应用于非文本思维的 Math-Shepherd 式自动标签可能含有噪声，后训练干预带来的重排序增益也仅属适度。虽然发布了代码，复现仍需要大量潜在模型和奖励模型训练；该工作对诊断限制的说服力强于提供通用补救方案。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper before transferring a textual verifier or Best-of-N pipeline to a latent reasoning system. It provides an audit sequence: first measure Pass@N to confirm candidate diversity, then measure reranking recovery, calibration, and representation separability before committing serving compute to a verifier. The released repository is relevant for research reproduction, while the cited Math-Shepherd dataset is a supervision dependency rather than a newly released benchmark.
在把文本验证器或最佳候选采样流程迁移到潜在推理系统之前，可使用这篇论文。它提供审计顺序：先测量通过率上界以确认候选多样性，再测量重排序恢复率、校准和表征可分性，然后才决定是否把服务计算投入验证器。发布的仓库适合研究复现，而被引用的 Math-Shepherd 数据集是监督依赖，不是论文新发布的基准。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the gap between Pass@N and reranking before focusing on the geometric regularizer. The decisive lesson is that inference-time sampling capacity and verification capacity must be evaluated separately; a large oracle gain is not a deployable gain. Compare the released code with the paper’s annotation protocol, because the automatic step labels and answer deduplication determine what the PRM actually learns to recognize.
在关注几何正则化之前，应先阅读通过率上界和重排序之间的缺口。决定性教训是，测试时采样能力和验证能力必须分别评估；较大的预知增益并不是可部署的增益。应将发布的代码与论文标注流程对照，因为自动步骤标签和答案去重决定了过程奖励模型实际学会识别什么。
